legend: Pep is late for his competitive programming lecture. His building has n+1%%ZSMJ0%% floors, and he lives on the floor n+1%%ZSMJ1%%. To go to college, he calls the elevator to his floor. Since he's superstitious, if the elevator stops on more than one floor besides the one it was on when he called and his floor, n+1%%ZSMJ2%%, he believes the day will be bad and goes back to bed.

While the elevator is moving, each floor i%%ZSMJ3%% has a probability pi%%ZSMJ4%% that the neighbor on floor i%%ZSMJ5%% will call the elevator at that moment, causing it to stop. Fortunately for Pep, his neighbors are not obsessed with constantly calling the elevator, that is, pi<100%%%ZSMJ6%% for 1≤i≤n%%ZSMJ7%%.

During the college semester, his neighbors may move out, and new neighbors may arrive, changing the probability pi%%ZSMJ8%% of floor i%%ZSMJ9%%. Pep would also like to make queries to determine the probability of going to class, given that the elevator would be on floor x%%ZSMJ10%% when he calls it.
input: The first line consists of two integers n%%ZSMJ11%% (3≤n≤2⋅105)%%ZSMJ12%% and q%%ZSMJ13%% (1≤q≤2⋅105)%%ZSMJ14%%.
The second line consists of n%%ZSMJ15%% integers pi%%ZSMJ16%% (0≤pi<100)%%ZSMJ17%%, representing the probability (in percentage) that the elevator will stop on floor i%%ZSMJ18%% while in motion.
The next q%%ZSMJ19%% lines correspond to queries of two types:
∙%%ZSMJ20%% 1%%ZSMJ21%% x%%ZSMJ22%% p%%ZSMJ23%%: Change the probability of floor x%%ZSMJ24%%, updating px%%ZSMJ25%% to p%%ZSMJ26%%.
∙%%ZSMJ27%% 2%%ZSMJ28%% x%%ZSMJ29%%: Answer with the probability that Pep will go to class, given that the elevator is on floor x%%ZSMJ30%% when he calls it.
output: For each query of type 2%%ZSMJ31%%, output a line with the queried probability. We can prove that this probability can be expressed as an irreducible fraction pq%%ZSMJ32%%. Print p⋅q−1%%ZSMJ33%% modulo (109+7)%%ZSMJ34%%.
note: The probability of not stopping on floors 2%%ZSMJ35%% and 3%%ZSMJ36%% is 14%%ZSMJ37%%.
The probability of stopping only on floor 2%%ZSMJ38%% is 14%%ZSMJ39%%.
The probability of stopping only on floor 3%%ZSMJ40%% is 14%%ZSMJ41%%.
